title: ToBI Prosodic Annotation
description: Multi-tier prosodic annotation following the Tones and Break Indices (ToBI) framework. Annotators label pitch accents, phrase accents, boundary tones, and break indices on speech utterances, producing a layered prosodic transcription aligned to the audio timeline (Silverman et al., ICSLP 1992).
